in_marathi.name: Manickam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manickam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manickam is a Tamil name derived from the Tamil word 'mani' meaning gem and 'kamam' meaning desire or wealth. It is believed to be the name of the god of wealth, Kubera. This name is a symbol of abundance, prosperity, and good fortune.
